or koTa (Ti) yuddhanirNaya jy. on appropriate time for military operations. IO. 6431. K. 224. L. 534. Mysore I. p. 332 (4 mss.).

Koṭacakrama_(?)_Pāśākevalīhorā
Pt.. See Arrah I. A. p. 40.

Koṭacatuṣṭaya
jy. by Jīvarāma Daivajña. CPB. 1089.

Koṭicakrayuddhayātrāyogaphala
jy. MD. 13646. 14028 (inc.).
See also Koṭaº.

Koṭitīrthamāhātmya
B. II. 40. IIO. Stein 50.
--from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa. Taylor II. 397 (chs. 1-3 inc.). [Page089-b]

Koṭitīrthamāhātmya
Pt.. with Hindi transl. with Siṁhasthamāhātmya from Skandapurāṇa. 1921. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1361.

Koṭitulasī
dh. CPB. 1090.

Koṭiniṣṭhaphalapradīpa
Bud. by Kamalaśrī. Cordier II. p. 228.

Koṭipārthiva
dh. CPB. 1091.

Koṭiyuddhacakra
jy. MD. 13647 (with Telugu C.).

Koṭiyūthanirṇaya
Adyar I. p. 108b.

Koṭiratnamahodadhi
by Śrī Gurutāraka Brahmānanda Sarasvatī. Rajapur 268.

Koṭirudrapraśna
MD. 17683.

Koṭirudrasaṃhitā
from Bhaviṣyapurāṇa. Burnell 203b.
--from Śivapurāṇa. Oudh XV. 20. RASB. V. 3534.
--Kapālīśasthalamāhātmya from. Whish 188.
See NCC. III. p. 151a.

Koṭiliṅganṛpati
Godavarman, Yuvarāja of Cranganore palace.
See under Godavarman.

Koṭiviraha
or zRGgAraketucarita kāvya in 107 verses, based on the Malayalam work Koṭiyaviraha (unbearable separation) of Mahiṣamaṅgalam Nārāyaṇan Nambūdiri; ascribed to Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa of Melputtūr. Oppert I. 2593. TCD. 1434A. Trav. Uni. C. 2239A. 2525D (inc.). 13502B (inc.). Trippūṇittura I. 319B. 336B.
See Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit. p. 147.
Pt.. K. M. Gucch. 5.

Koṭiśa
poet ref. to by Rājaśekhara in his Karpūramañjarī, K. M. edn. p. 21. [Page090-a.

Koṭisārabhaṭṭa
father of Padmanābha Deśika, an. grandfather of Devarāja Bhaṭṭa (a. of Rāmābhiṣekacampū, MT. 1516 (a.).

Koṭihoma
31st Pariśiṣṭa of Av. in 10 khaṇḍas. Mu7nchen 183 (35). Weber 365 (31).
Pt.. Ath. Pariśiṣṭa Leipzig: Halle, 1909.

Koṭihomapaddhati
p.. Adyar I. p. 88b. Kavīndrācārya 765. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1917-18, p. 7 (no. 2772).
--according to Parāśara. Baroda 9123 (c) (inc.).

Koṭihomaprayoga
gṛh. Burnell 148a. TD. 13967.
--by Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa. TD. 13966.

Koṭihomaprayoga
śr. by Rāmakṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa, son of Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa. AS. p. 51. Baroda 3852. 9633. 11141.

Koṭihomavidhāna
according to Parāśara. Baroda 9123 (c) (with Paddhati) (inc.).

Koṭihomavidhi
Nasik II. 262.
--by Vṛndāvana. NP. III. 50. NW. 242.

Koṭihomavidhikuṇḍavicāra(sūkṣmagaṇitānītakuṇḍaparimāṇe)
Harshe p. 49.

Koṭihomaśatamukhādiprayogapaddhati
by Rāmakṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa. NP. V. 56.

Koṭīśvarakṣetramāhātmya
from Padmapurāṇa, Puṣkarakhaṇḍa. IO. 6624.

Koṭīśvaratīrthaprabhāva
from Narmadākhaṇḍa of Skandapurāṇa. Lz. 324.

Koṭīśvaramāhātmya
on the Kanara coast to the north of Kondapur; from Sahyādrikhaṇḍa of Skandapurāṇa. B. II. 40. IO. 6912. Mack 68.

Koṭīśvarīvratakathā
from Skandapurāṇa. Ben. 55.

Koṭṭadeva(rajuka)
composed the Indore plates of Vākāṭaka King Pravarasena II (d. 433 A. D.). See Epi. Ind. XXIV. p.. 54. 56. [Page090-b]

Koṭyaṇa
another name of Kumāreśvara, father of Amarānandayogīndra (a. of C. Viṣṇuvallabhā on Viṣṇupurāṇa, GD. 474).
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 337a. IV. p. 201a.

Koṭyarkabhaktipradīpa
on the worship of Koṭyarka for the use of Kharait sect of Vaiṣṇavas; Skt. texts with Gujarati transl.., an. C.s. by Somā Bāi Maṅgaladāsa.
Pt.. Ahmedabad, 1901. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 654.

Koṭyarkamāhātmya
from Padmapurāṇa.
Pt.. with Gujarati C. Ahmedabad, 1872.

Koṭyācārya
Jain. his identity with Śilāṅkasūri is improbable.
See Kapadia, Canonical Lit. of the Jainas, p.. 200-02, C.. notes on BORI. D. XVII. iii. 1106; an. Skt. Intro. to Viśeṣāvaśyakabhāṣya edn. noted below. Probably pupil of Jinabhadragaṇi Kṣamāśramaṇa (a. of Kṣetrasamāsa, BBRAS. 1589).
--C. on Viśeṣāvaśyakabhāṣya. BORI. D. XVII. iii. 1106.
Ed. by Anandasagarasuri, Rutlam, 2 Vol.. 1936-7.
